title: Device
description: What this device holds of a profile, device/<id>.json (section 4 of the text of the part): its unfinished attempts with their history, its essays and its places in lessons.

format.description: The version of the part, the integer in export/VERSION.

items.description: An unfinished attempt as this device holds it.

attempts.description: The unfinished attempts this device holds.

items.description: An essay as this device holds it.

essays.description: The essays this device holds, with what was read and the feedback.

items.description: A lesson's place as this device holds it.

lessons.description: The places in the unfinished lessons.

ticks.description: The ticks of what is given and what is to be found, as app keeps them.

items.description: The IDs of the techniques the learner got: one of them.

technique_ids.description: The IDs of the techniques the learner got.

attempt_id.description: The unfinished attempt, by its ID in api.

history.description: The history of writing as the canvas gave it: write/erase/clear/undo events with t; strokes with id, kind and points x, y, t, p.

items.description: Each submission's context (SheetSubmission or WorkbookSubmission, as the canvas gave it) and the history length when it was sent; the PNG work is not exported: one of them.

submissions.description: Each submission's context (SheetSubmission or WorkbookSubmission, as the canvas gave it) and the history length when it was sent; the PNG work is not exported.

step_state.description: The attempt's mode, the step's place, the ticks of the chips and the technique IDs received.

attempt_id.description: The essay's attempt, finished or not.

module_version_withdrawn.description: Whether the module version was withdrawn, so the essay goes without the task's statement.

history.description: The history of writing of the essay.

text.description: What was read of the essay.

segment.description: The number of the segment of the lesson.

demo_state.description: The state of showing of the segment, as the element gave it, in its own names.

lesson.description: The lesson's full ID, part of the key.

package_digest.description: The package digest, the rest of the key.

lesson_run_id.description: The run the state belongs to.

place.description: The segment the learner has reached, from 1.

items.description: The demo state of each worked example, {opened, hidden}, by segment place: one of them.

demo_states.description: The demo state of each worked example, {opened, hidden}, by segment place.
